title: Adjacent differential compatibility of external Alexander--Whitney degree maps
statement: Let k,f,g,U,V,F,G be as in [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree]. Suppose a family l_(p,q) of k-linear bidegree maps is given, each with the prescribed front/back pure-tensor coordinates. Define t_n from the tensor-total degree n to the product-cover degree n by the coproduct universal property and the target-degree equality p+q=n. Then for every n in ℕ, t_n followed by the target differential n→n+1 equals the source tensor-total differential n→n+1 followed by t_(n+1). This is a differential identity for specified maps and asserts no existence of a cochain morphism.

source.place: Equation 33.29.1.1 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07MB, equation 20.25.3.2; official pages read on 2026-10-13

proof.text: Precompose with each (p,q) tensor-total inclusion with p+q=n. Reduce the adjacent differential identity to the inclusion-level coordinate calculation.
Apply the inclusion-level theorem to every p,q with p+q=n. The coproduct universal property and HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext conclude the adjacent equation for the assembled degree maps.

proof_origin.place: Reduction by tensor-total inclusion extensionality to the inclusion-level signed face calculation.

theorem picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps_comm
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (l : ∀ p q : ℕ, ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
          (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (hl : ∀ p q, IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q (l p q)) (n : ℕ) :
    picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps f g U V F G l n ≫
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d n (n + 1) =
      (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
        ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).d n (n + 1) ≫
        picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps f g U V F G l (n + 1)
